description.value: Flamez Chicken is a fried and flame-grilled chicken restaurant in the heart of Downtown Nanaimo, located at the corner of Wallace and Fitzwilliam streets. The menu spans signature fried chicken, grilled options, poutines, seafood, wraps, rice bowls, and house-made sauces, with catering available for groups. Positioned near the Harbourfront Walkway and ferry terminal, it sits in a convenient spot for cyclists exploring downtown Nanaimo.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the business is operating at 299 Wallace St, Nanaimo with a matching phone number (250-866-0111) and email in the footer. The menu page lists 'Seafood & Vegetarian' as a category and a customer review explicitly mentions 'great veggie options, kid-friendly, and wheelchair accessible,' supporting vegetarian options. The website prominently offers pick-up and delivery ordering, confirming takeout. No evidence for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or most other cycling amenities was found. The website has significant spam/malware injection (gambling casino content mixed into page text), which is flagged as a concern but does not obscure the core business information.
concerns: Website (flamez.ca) contains extensive injected gambling/casino spam text throughout all pages — the site appears to have been compromised by SEO spam malware. Core business content is still present and consistent, but the site's integrity is questionable.
OSM phone tag uses E.164 format (+1 250 866 0111); website footer shows 250-866-0111 — same number, different formatting, no substantive discrepancy.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate operating restaurant with takeout and vegetarian options useful to cyclists, but no bike parking or other cycling-specific amenities are confirmed. A site visit or direct contact is needed to verify the required bike parking/visibility criterion before inclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website footer also lists email nanaimo@flamez.ca, not present in OSM tags.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes a dedicated 'Seafood & Vegetarian' category; customer review states 'Great veggie options.'
